svg.title: Arda Çabuk — embedded software and machine learning
svg.desc: A ray-marched practice room drawn in ASCII. Someone with short curly dark-blond hair, a pale hoodie and red headphones plays a red drum kit under a warm spotlight, with a red light glowing behind; the front head of the bass drum reads ARDA ÇABUK. Every hit flashes the drum it lands on and throws code into the air: keywords and symbols fly up out of the snare and the toms, the crash throws a fountain of them, the ride flicks a single symbol and the kick lets bits drift up, all arcing and fading from white to olive. Three bars of groove end in a fill around the toms. A black cat sits on the amp beside the kit.
